_meta.note: Extracted byte-identical from SummonBannerCatalog.cs and SummonRoller.cs (tunables-ssot.md M.8, 2026-08-24). Banner ids/HasElementFocus stay in C# (schema); costs and pity/rarity math moved. `roller` redesigned 2026-09-01 (seed-to-concrete T4.1, owner Q15: 'All ten, two pity guards at 70 and 90') from a flat common/rare/epic/legendary split to all ten ladder rungs. Per-mille rates are a monotonically decreasing staircase (chaff, the implicit remainder, down to almanac at 2‰) — a STARTING VALUE, not a validated balance decision, per this spec's own explicit 'ask first' boundary on the summon-rate spread (spec-rarity-migration.md §5). The two named pity guards are ordinals from ssot-rarity.md §3.3: heirloom=70, sunwoven=90 — almanac (ordinal 100, the true top) is deliberately NOT pity-guarded, matching Q15's literal '70 and 90'. Pull-count fields (heirloomHardPity, sunwovenSoftStart, sunwovenHardPity) are unchanged from the old epicHardPity/legendarySoftStart/legendaryHardPity values — they gate on PULL COUNT, not on rarity width, so widening the ladder does not by itself change what they should be.
